name: Progress loaders
description: Six small indicators that show an amount, drawn in the current colour: spokes, a count, a capsule, a pie, steps and a ring that ends in a check.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in pixels. Twelve spokes light in turn clockwise from twelve o'clock.

props.name: label
props.description: Text for screen readers. Without value the loader has role="status"; with value it is the progress bar's accessible name.

props.name: value
props.description: Amount from 0 to 100. With it the loader shows that amount, follows changes with a 200ms settle and has role="progressbar". Without it the loader fills, holds and starts again.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one fill when looping. The hold and fade that follow scale with it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. The colour is currentColor, water by default. Other span props are passed through.
